children: Kothari took charge in October 2024, after spending nearly 30 years across various leadership roles within the group
Manish Kothari, Group President and Head – Commercial Bank at Kotak Mahindra Bank, has resigned from his position, bringing an end to a more than three-decade association with the Kotak Group.

Kothari took charge as Group President and Head of Commercial Banking in October 2024, after spending nearly 30 years across various leadership roles within the group. He joined the organisation in 1995 as part of the corporate finance relationship team, when the business operated as Kotak Mahindra Finance.

Over the years, Kothari played a key role in building and scaling Kotak’s wholesale and commercial credit business, with his responsibilities spanning corporate banking, mid-corporate relationships and financial solutions.

From 2009 to 2022, he served as President and Business Head – Corporate Banking for more than 13 years. In the role, he managed relationships across large corporates, multinational companies, SMEs and new-age businesses, following the integration of the Mid-Corporate division into the Corporate Banking Group.
Earlier, Kothari was Executive Vice President and Business Head – Mid Corporates, where he led corporate finance solutions across leasing, bill discounting, loan syndication and working capital debt.

His departure marks the end of a long leadership journey at Kotak, during which he held several senior roles and was closely involved in the evolution of the bank’s wholesale and commercial banking businesses.
